The Nigeria Premier Football League Matchday 12 fixture between Sporting Lagos and Rivers United has been postponed indefinitely, with a new date to be announced in the coming days. The league announced the decision on its official X handle on Saturday. The game was scheduled for Saturday at the Mobolaji Johnson Arena, popularly known as Onikan Stadium, in Lagos. “EUROMATCHNPFL UPDATE. The Matchday 12 fixture between Sporting Lagos and Rivers United has been postponed indefinitely. A new date will be announced in the days ahead,” they wrote on X. Sporting Lagos had first announced the delay on Thursday, saying the venue would not be available. The club did not give further details on why the stadium could not be used. It said fans who had already bought tickets would be contacted by email. The other Matchday 12 fixtures are still scheduled to go ahead across various venues this weekend. Add us to your Preferred Sources It is not the first time the Tech Boys have faced venue problems at Onikan this season, as a similar issue affected an earlier Lagos derby. The stadium is also used by other Lagos clubs, including Ikorodu City and Inter Lagos, who both hosted league matches there in recent weeks. The delay disrupts Rivers United, who had been preparing for the trip under Finidi George. The Pride of Rivers are third on 18 points from 11 matches, with four wins, level on points with Bendel Insurance and three behind leaders Rangers. They drew 1-1 at home with Rangers last Sunday, and their unbeaten start to the season ended with a 2-1 defeat away to Bendel on October 25. Sporting are 11th on 15 points from only 10 matches, with four wins. They have been among the most impressive sides on the road this season, and they will want a stable home base as the campaign continues. Coach Buter was also recently summoned by the league over remarks about referees.
